---
title: "RESOLVE App"
---

Impute the habitat
([EUNIS](https://www.eea.europa.eu/en/datahub/datahubitem-view/123d0c9a-a6fa-4f2d-b887-5d8e5468faed)),
the phytosociological alliance, site metadata (altitude,
slope, location) and survey metadata (plot area, survey year) of vegetation
plots from their species composition and
cover-abundance, with the released RESOLVE models. The models were trained on
the plots of the [European Vegetation Archive (EVA)](https://euroveg.org/eva-database)
([Chytrý et al. 2016](https://doi.org/10.1111/avsc.12191)), which brings together
the plots of national and regional vegetation databases; the models exist
thanks to their custodians and the many people who recorded and contributed
these plots. The models run locally in your browser; your files are not uploaded.
The page downloads the models and the elevation model from Zenodo
([models](https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.24079624),
[elevation model](https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.24075925)), the map from
OpenStreetMap and, for a map download, the country boundaries from Eurostat
GISCO.

```{=html}
<link rel="stylesheet" href="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/leaflet/1.9.4/leaflet.min.css">
<link rel="stylesheet" href="../app/app.css">
<div id="resolve-app"
     data-models-pack="https://zenodo.org/api/records/24079624/files/models.tar/content
                       https://huggingface.co/gcol33/resolve-models/resolve/zenodo-24079624/models.tar"
     data-models-index="https://zenodo.org/api/records/24079624/files/models.index.json/content
                        https://huggingface.co/gcol33/resolve-models/resolve/zenodo-24079624/models.index.json"
     data-terrain-field="https://zenodo.org/api/records/24075925/files/terrain_field.bin/content"
     data-examples="../app/examples/">
  <div id="loader" role="status" aria-live="polite">
    <div class="hex">
      <img class="logo base" src="../logo.svg" alt="">
      <img class="logo fill" id="hex-fill" src="../logo.svg" alt="RESOLVE">
    </div>
    <p id="loader-step">Reading the model list…</p>
  </div>

  <div id="tool" hidden>
    <div class="card mt-3" role="region" aria-labelledby="data-h">
      <div class="card-body">
        <p class="card-title h5" id="data-h">Data</p>
        <p class="small text-body-secondary" id="example-note" hidden></p>
        <div class="tables">
          <div>
            <label class="form-label small d-block" for="species-file">Species table: one row per species record, with
              plot ID, species name (World Flora Online), and optionally cover-abundance (%), genus and family. Columns are
              matched by name (Darwin Core names too); change them below if needed.</label>
            <input class="form-control form-control-sm" type="file" id="species-file" accept=".csv,.tsv,.txt">
            <div class="fields small" id="species-fields"></div>
            <div class="info small text-body-secondary" id="species-info"></div>
            <div class="error small" id="species-error"></div>
          </div>
          <div>
            <label class="form-label small d-block" for="header-file">Header table (optional): one row per plot, with
              plot ID, latitude and longitude (WGS84), and year and month or a date. Where a header
              column is missing on some plots, the imputed values are calibrated on the plots that record it
              (opt-out).</label>
            <input class="form-control form-control-sm" type="file" id="header-file" accept=".csv,.tsv,.txt">
            <div class="fields small" id="header-fields"></div>
            <div class="info small text-body-secondary" id="header-info"></div>
            <div class="error small" id="header-error"></div>
          </div>
        </div>
        <div class="options">
          <label>Fuzzy match species names
            <select class="form-select form-select-sm" id="o-spelling">
              <option value="0">off</option>
              <option value="1" selected>up to 1 edit</option>
              <option value="2">up to 2 edits</option>
              <option value="3">up to 3 edits</option>
            </select></label>
        </div>
        <button type="button" class="btn btn-link btn-sm p-0 mt-2" id="reset-data" hidden>Use the example data again</button>
      </div>
    </div>

    <div class="card mt-3" role="region" aria-labelledby="models-h">
      <div class="card-body">
        <p class="card-title h5" id="models-h">Models</p>
        <div class="choices" id="targets"></div>
        <div class="options">
          <label class="form-check-label" id="terrain-option" hidden><input class="form-check-input" type="checkbox"
            id="o-terrain" checked> Terrain correction of altitude and slope</label>
          <label class="form-check-label" id="gaps-option" hidden><input class="form-check-input" type="checkbox"
            id="o-gaps" checked> Calibrate imputed values to input data</label>
        </div>
        <div class="actions">
          <button type="button" class="btn btn-primary" id="run" disabled>Impute</button>
          <label class="small">Workers <input class="form-control form-control-sm d-inline-block" type="number"
            id="o-workers" min="1" max="16" step="1"></label>
          <span id="status" class="small text-body-secondary" role="status"></span>
        </div>
        <div id="busy" class="mt-2" hidden>
          <div class="busy-line small">
            <span><svg id="busy-pulse" viewBox="-6 -6 12 12" aria-hidden="true"><path
              d="M0 -4.6V4.6M-4 -2.3L4 2.3M-4 2.3L4 -2.3"/></svg><span id="busy-verb"></span></span>
            <span><span id="busy-share"></span> · <span id="busy-time"></span></span>
          </div>
          <div class="progress" role="progressbar" aria-label="Share of the run done" aria-valuemin="0"
               aria-valuemax="100"><div class="progress-bar" id="busy-bar"></div></div>
        </div>
        <p id="download-status" class="small text-body-secondary mt-2 mb-0"></p>
      </div>
    </div>

    <div id="results" hidden>
      <div class="stats mt-3">
        <div class="stat"><b id="s-plots"></b><span>plots</span></div>
        <div class="stat"><b id="s-variables"></b><span>variables imputed</span></div>
        <div class="stat"><b id="s-unknown"></b><span>species names not recognised</span></div>
        <div class="stat"><b id="s-time"></b><span>to impute</span></div>
      </div>

      <div class="row g-3 mt-0">
        <div class="col-lg-7" id="map-panel"><div class="card h-100">
          <div class="card-body">
            <div class="tablehead">
              <p class="card-title h5 mb-0">Plots</p>
              <div class="map-controls">
                <div class="btn-group btn-group-sm" role="group" aria-label="Map view">
                  <input type="radio" class="btn-check" name="map-view" id="map-view-points" value="points" autocomplete="off" checked>
                  <label class="btn btn-outline-secondary" for="map-view-points">Points</label>
                  <input type="radio" class="btn-check" name="map-view" id="map-view-grid" value="grid" autocomplete="off">
                  <label class="btn btn-outline-secondary" for="map-view-grid">Grid</label>
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>
            <div id="map" role="region" aria-label="Map of the plots"></div>
            <div class="legend" id="legend"></div>
            <div class="actions">
              <button type="button" class="btn btn-outline-primary btn-sm" id="download-map" disabled>Download map (SVG)</button>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div></div>

        <div class="col-lg-5" id="variable-panel"><div class="card h-100">
          <div class="card-body">
            <div class="tablehead">
              <p class="card-title h5 mb-0" id="variable-title" aria-live="polite"></p>
              <div class="btn-group btn-group-sm" id="variable-step" hidden>
                <button type="button" class="btn btn-outline-secondary" id="variable-prev" aria-label="Previous variable">&lsaquo;</button>
                <button type="button" class="btn btn-outline-secondary" id="variable-next" aria-label="Next variable">&rsaquo;</button>
              </div>
            </div>
            <ul class="types" id="summary"></ul>
          </div>
        </div></div>
      </div>

      <div class="card mt-3">
        <div class="card-body">
          <div class="tablehead">
            <p class="card-title h5 mb-0">Imputed values</p>
            <nav class="pager" id="pager" aria-label="Table pages" hidden>
              <span id="pager-range" class="small text-body-secondary" aria-live="polite"></span>
              <div class="btn-group btn-group-sm">
                <button type="button" class="btn btn-outline-secondary" id="pager-first" aria-label="First page">&laquo;</button>
                <button type="button" class="btn btn-outline-secondary" id="pager-prev" aria-label="Previous page">&lsaquo;</button>
                <button type="button" class="btn btn-outline-secondary" id="pager-next" aria-label="Next page">&rsaquo;</button>
                <button type="button" class="btn btn-outline-secondary" id="pager-last" aria-label="Last page">&raquo;</button>
              </div>
            </nav>
          </div>
          <div class="tablewrap"><table class="table table-sm table-hover mb-0" id="table"></table></div>
          <div class="actions">
            <button type="button" class="btn btn-outline-primary btn-sm" id="download" disabled>Download all imputed values (CSV)</button>
          </div>
          <ul class="warn small text-body-secondary" id="gaps" hidden></ul>
          <details class="small mt-3" id="unknown" hidden><summary></summary>
            <p class="text-body-secondary mt-2"></p><ul></ul></details>
          <details class="small mt-3" id="moved" hidden><summary></summary>
            <p class="text-body-secondary mt-2"></p><ul></ul></details>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>

    <div class="notes small text-body-secondary mt-4">
      <p>Each variable is imputed by five models, trained in the same way from different random starting points
      (seeds), and the page combines their five values: habitat by majority vote (seed agreement is the share of
      the five naming the habitat), numeric variables by their mean and standard deviation, and location by the
      spherical mean and the median distance of the five from it.</p>
      <p>Altitude and slope can also be corrected with an elevation model (Copernicus GLO-30). The correction weighs
      the imputed value against the elevation model's value at the plot and over the square kilometre around it,
      depending on the plot's location uncertainty, the spread of the five values and how many of the plot's
      species the models know. The table gives the elevation model's own values beside the corrected ones.</p>
      <p>Terrain values produced using Copernicus WorldDEM-30 © DLR e.V. 2010-2014 and © Airbus Defence and Space
      GmbH 2014-2018 provided under COPERNICUS by the European Union and ESA; all rights reserved. The organisations
      in charge of the Copernicus programme by law or by delegation do not incur any liability for any use of the
      Copernicus WorldDEM-30.</p>
    </div>

    <p id="footer" class="small text-body-secondary mt-3">runs on
      <a href="https://onnxruntime.ai/">ONNX Runtime Web</a> · <span id="workers"></span></p>
  </div>
</div>
<script src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/leaflet/1.9.4/leaflet.min.js"></script>
<script type="module" src="../app/app.js"></script>
```
